source:
[u][b]The Air-headed and Cheerful Vampire Oppai Bunny!♥[/b][/u]
Race: Vampire (Maginese Tribe)
First Year at Lepus Rabirio Bunny Academy
Wholesome Cheerleading Club Member

She was first-year student at Usaki Academy who transferred to the other world together with the protagonist, while also being a junior member of the app development club (She mainly handled illustrations for bishoujo game development.) She has a ridiculously large bust size that doesn’t match her age.

Her personality is bright and lively. Despite her mature figure, she’s quite a spoiled child. She also has a bad habit of being too easily forgiving when praised. She often makes meta-comments and sharp-tongued remarks.

She loves the protagonist very much, but when trying to appeal to him, she often gets so nervous that she maxes out. (She was super happy when he really praised her drawings.) She also has a complex about being tall, and worries about whether the protagonist sees her as a cute girl. (She is completely unaware that she has an outstandingly lewd body.)

When they transferred into the world of the game that the protagonist had been creating, she ended up being assigned the race setting of a Vampire. Since it was based on the vampire setting from the bishoujo game the protagonist created, she was given the perverted trait requiring the daily routine of [b]breastfeeding for magic replenishment[/b]. (She's now part of a race of vampires that doesn't suck blood. They have to replenish their magic by having their breasts sucked.) She was also apparently given the character trait "lucky pervert constitution."

She belongs to the Wholesome Cheerleading Club that exists in the game created by the protagonist. The club advisor is the protagonist.

Her hobbies include drawing, love fortune-telling, and her "daily magic replenishment." Before transferring, she would sometimes post her drawings on social media.

Regarding the bunny outfit, she worries whether her tall and busty figure suits it. She is anxious about whether the protagonist will praise her. (Although she’s embarrassed about it...♥)

The Maginese are a special race of vampires that dislike the night-time and have extrovert personalities.
